AboutDialog.construit_cu_qt_glm_earcut_m:
Built with Qt, glm, earcut, Manifold, tinygltf, miniz, nlohmann/json.
Fonts: Inter and Geist Mono (OFL). Icons: Lucide (ISC).
ArrayPanel.mm_pas_negativ_in_sens_invers: mm. A negative step goes the other way.
BevelPanel.merge_pe_muchii_convexe_dintr: Works on convex edges between two flat faces (as on a box). On a face, all of its sides are bevelled.
CameraFrame.orbit_pan_zoom_muta_camera_u: Orbit / pan / zoom move the camera (one undo step per gesture)
EntityInfo.actualizeaza_keyframe_ul_la_m: Update the keyframe at the current time
EntityInfo.copii_legate_fa_unic_pentru_o: linked copies. Use “Make unique” for a separate variant.
EntityInfo.cu_unealta_interact_mana_din_: With the Interact tool (the hand in the toolbar), a click on the object opens or closes it. A negative angle = reverse direction.
EntityInfo.dimensiunile_se_masoara_din_g: Dimensions are measured from the geometry; the type and thickness are kept for the cut list.
EntityInfo.generator_vechi_placile_nu_au: Old generator: the boards have no type, HDF back or hardware. “Update” rebuilds it as a “Wardrobe” / “Rack” with the same dimensions.
EntityInfo.inainte_de_a_lungul_caii_la_s: ”: forward (along the path), left, up and the rotation relative to the travel direction. Move / Rotate still move the object relative to the path.
EntityInfo.mai_multe_segmente_fac_curba_: More segments make the curve smoother. After Push/Pull or Subdivide they can no longer be changed.
EntityInfo.pozitioneaza_cu_mouse_ul_trag: Position with the mouse (drag; Shift rotates, ⌘ scales)
EntityInfo.pune_un_keyframe_la_momentul_: Set a keyframe at the current time
EntityInfo.rotatia_si_scara_se_fac_in_ju: Rotation and scale happen around the pivot (the center by default). Rotation and scale start at 0° / 1 for each new selection.
EntityInfo.segmentele_se_pot_schimba_doa: Segments can only be changed before Push/Pull (while the shape is not part of a volume).
InteractionsPanel.nicio_interactiune_sel: No interactions. Select an object and press + to add block rules (“When I click → Move…”).
LibraryPanel.obiectele_tale_selecteaza_u: Your objects: select an object and press + in the header (“Save to library”).
Main.adauga_o_camera_din_vederea_curenta: Add a camera (from the current view)
Main.adauga_o_forma_o_camera_sau_o_lumin: Add a shape, a camera or a light
Main.antialiasing_progresiv_cat_camera_s: Progressive antialiasing (while the camera is still)
Main.array_copii_in_linie_sau_in_cerc: Array: copies in a line or a circle…
Main.bevel_rotunjeste_muchiile_sau_fata: Bevel (round the edges or the face)…
Main.care_a_ramas_fara_scurtatura: ”, which is now without a shortcut.
Main.chamfer_teseste_plat_muchiile_sau_f: Chamfer (flat-cut the edges or the face)…

The carcass becomes plain: it is no longer rebuilt from its fields.
Main.creeaza_componenta_copiile_raman_le: Make component (copies stay linked; appears in Library → In model)
Main.creeaza_fete_din_muchiile_selectate: Create faces from the selected edges
Main.creeaza_intai_o_animatie_in_timelin: Create an animation in the timeline first.
Main.daca_nu_le_salvezi_se_pierd: If you don't save them, they are lost.
Main.datele_de_piesa_tip_grosime_cant_sa: The part data (type, thickness, edge banding) or the library link is lost.
Main.editeaza_grupul_sau_obiectul_select: Edit the selected group or object
Main.exportul_video_nu_e_disponibil_in_b: Video export is not available in the browser (use the desktop app).
Main.fa_placa_pal_pentru_lista_de_debita: Make board (PAL, for the cut list)
Main.iesi_din_grupul_sau_obiectul_editat: Leave the edited group or object
Main.imaginea_nu_a_putut_fi_salvata: The image could not be saved.
Main.incadreaza_toata_animatia_in_timeli: Fit the whole animation in the timeline
Main.interactiune_noua_pentru_obiectul_s: New interaction for the selected object
Main.interactiuni_cu_blocuri_pentru_obie: Block interactions for the selected object…
Main.intersecteaza_fetele_selectate_cu_m: Intersect the selected faces with the model
Main.intersecteaza_fetele_selectate_intr: Intersect the selected faces with each other
Main.la_inceputul_animatiei: To the start of the animation
Main.la_sfarsitul_animatiei: To the end of the animation
Main.lipeste_click_pentru_loc_esc_renunt: Paste (click for the place, Esc cancels)
Main.masoara_fps_roteste_camera_4_s: Measure fps (rotate the camera for 4 s)
Main.muchii_netede_soften_ascunde_muchii: Smooth edges (Soften: hide edges under an angle)…
Main.obiectul_nu_are_interactiuni_alege_: The object has no interactions. Choose Select and add one from the Inspector.
Main.opreste_animatia_sau_click_in_viewp: Stop the animation (or click in the viewport)
Main.orbita_in_jurul_punctului_de_sub_cu: Orbit: around the point under the pointer
Main.orbiteaza_in_jurul_punctului_de_sub: Orbit around the point under the pointer
Main.raport_de_cantitati_arii_volume_deb: Quantity report (areas, volumes, furniture cut list)…
Main.salveaza_obiectul_selectat_in_bibli: Save the selected object to the library
Main.scena_noua_din_vederea_curenta: New scene from the current view
Main.scoti_piesa_din_corp: Take the part out of the carcass?
Main.se_exporta_animatia_progresul_e_in_: Exporting the animation… (progress is in the timeline)
Main.selecteaza_ceva_ca_sa_i_vezi_propri: Select something to see its properties. Style, shadows, sections and projection are in the bar in the viewport corner.
Main.selecteaza_o_camera_in_outliner_la_: Select a camera (in the Outliner, under Cameras and lights).
Main.selecteaza_un_grup_sau_o_componenta: Select a group or a component to add interactions to it.
Main.selecteaza_un_obiect_ca_sa_l_salvez: Select an object to save it to the library.
Main.solide_scade_al_doilea_din_primul: Solids: subtract the second from the first
Main.subdivide_imparte_fetele_si_rotunje: Subdivide (split the faces and round the object)…
Main.turul_uneltelor_cum_se_foloseste_fi: Tool tour (how to use each one)
Main.unealta_nu_e_disponibila_in_modul: The tool is not available in the mode
Main.unele_piese_au_fost_modificate_de_m: Some parts were changed by hand (shape, size or position); rebuilding loses those changes. To keep them: “Make a plain carcass”.
MaterialsPanel.marimea_reala_a_unei_repe: Real size of one repeat. The color tints the texture (white = unchanged).
MaterialsPanel.niciun_material_in_model_: No material in the model. Pick one from the library or create your own with +.
ObjectInfo.adauga_click_pe_un_obiect_in_: Add: click an object in the viewport
ObjectInfo.claritate_doar_la_distanta_de: Sharp only at the focus distance
ObjectInfo.click_in_viewport_pe_punctul_: Click the sharp point in the viewport…
ObjectInfo.niciun_obiect_apasa_si_da_cli: No objects. Press + and click an object. Several objects line up in a column; move them to arrange them differently.
ObjectInfo.obiectele_ei_se_misca_doar_ca: ”: its objects move only while its animation is active.
ObjectInfo.pune_camera_in_vederea_curent: Set the camera to the current view
ObjectInfo.pune_lumina_in_vederea_curent: Set the light to the current view
ObjectInfo.scoate_de_pe_cale_revine_unde: Remove from the path (returns where it was)
ObjectInfo.un_singur_spot_cu_umbre_la_un: Only one spotlight casts shadows at a time (the first in the list). Drag the marker in the viewport (Shift = vertically).
Outliner.ascunde_marcajul_din_viewport: Hide the marker in the viewport
Outliner.niciun_obiect_selecteaza_forme_: No objects. Select shapes and press ⌘G to make an object; objects are grouped with ⌥⌘G. Or create a cube, a sphere… directly from the toolbar.
PreferencesPage.0_automat_dupa_distanta_: 0 = automatic (from the camera distance and the model size).
PreferencesPage.ajutorul_din_aplicatie_e: In-app help, the start screen and recent documents.
PreferencesPage.arata_fps_in_bara_de_jos: Show fps in the bottom bar
PreferencesPage.auto_milimetri_sub_1_m_m: Auto: millimetres under 1 m, metres above. Values typed without a unit are read in the chosen unit.
PreferencesPage.auto_urmeaza_grid_ul_afi: Auto follows the displayed grid (changes with zoom).
PreferencesPage.calitatea_randarii_lumin: Rendering quality, lighting and viewport information.
PreferencesPage.cantul_cum_se_vede_in_vi: Edge banding: how it shows in the viewport and how much is added per edge in the cut list.
PreferencesPage.cat_cant_in_plus_se_numa: How much extra banding is counted per edge (trimming, machine grip).
PreferencesPage.cauta_o_comanda_sau_o_sc: Search for a command or a shortcut
PreferencesPage.click_pe_scurtatura_si_a: Click a shortcut and press the new combination. Esc cancels, Backspace clears it. A combination already in use moves to the new command.
PreferencesPage.colturile_si_contactele_: Darker corners and contacts between objects.
PreferencesPage.copiile_de_recuperare_al: Recovery copies of the open document.
PreferencesPage.culoarea_luminii_ambient: The ambient light color and the reflections on smooth surfaces (glass, metal, lacquer).
PreferencesPage.cum_se_afiseaza_si_cum_s: How lengths are shown and read.
PreferencesPage.doar_cand_documentul_are: Only when the document has unsaved changes. Offered on restart if the app closed unexpectedly; your file is not overwritten.
PreferencesPage.doar_punctele_fara_alta_: Only points with no other inference (endpoint, midpoint, edge) and distances along directions.
PreferencesPage.gol_sau_egal_cu_cel_gene: Empty or equal to the general one = the general one.
PreferencesPage.grid_ul_de_pe_sol_si_pri: The ground grid and snapping points to it.
PreferencesPage.in_jurul_carui_punct_se_: Which point the camera rotates around when orbiting.
PreferencesPage.la_pornire_document_nou_: On launch: new document, open, the last file and recent documents. After a crash it appears anyway, with the recovery copy.
PreferencesPage.laturile_placilor_cu_can: Board sides with edge banding are drawn in the banding decor color.
PreferencesPage.margini_mai_fine_cu_came: Finer edges while the camera is still
PreferencesPage.orbita_zoom_ul_si_planur: Orbit, zoom and the camera clipping planes.
PreferencesPage.pentru_pozitia_soarelui_: For the sun position and shadows.
PreferencesPage.performanta_modele_mari_: Performance: large models or slower computers. Quality: the finest edges and shadows.
PreferencesPage.punctele_libere_cad_pe_g: Free points snap to the grid
PreferencesPage.se_aplica_dupa_repornire: Applies after a restart. Some messages from the modeling core are still in Romanian. The “beta” languages fall back to English where they have no translation.
PreferencesPage.tastele_comenzilor_si_al: The keys of commands and tools; click one to change it.
PreferencesPage.tema_culoarea_de_accent_: The theme, the accent color and the interface colors.
PreferencesPage.toate_scurtaturile_au_re: All shortcuts are back to the defaults.
PreferencesPage.trece_la_8_cat_camera_st: Goes to 8× while the camera is still.
PreferencesPage.un_ghid_scurt_apare_cand: A short guide appears when you hold the pointer over a toolbar tool.
PreferencesPage.zoom_spre_suprafata_de_s: Zoom toward the surface under the pointer
PreferencesPage.zoom_ul_incetineste_lang: Zoom slows down near details and does not pass through them.
QuantitiesDialog.csv_pentru_excel_separa: CSV for Excel: “;” separator, decimal comma, UTF-8.
QuantitiesDialog.dimensiuni_de_taiere_fa: Cut dimensions (without the deducted edge banding)
QuantitiesDialog.nicio_piesa_adauga_plac: No parts. Add boards from the Library, or group each panel (⌘G) and use “Make board”.
QuantitiesDialog.piesele_ascunse_debifat: Unchecked hidden parts are not in the CSV.
QuantitiesDialog.placile_cu_tip_din_bibl: Typed boards (from the Library or “Make board”) are measured on their own axes and grouped by type, thickness, dimensions, decor and edge banding; hardware is counted in pieces. Objects without a type are listed by their material category; wood or decor ones are marked “undefined type”. Uncheck the rows that should not go into the quote and the CSV.
RulesActionList.trage_aici_blocuri_din_p: Drag blocks here from the palette
RulesEditor.nicio_regula_trage_un_evenim: No rules. Drag a yellow event (e.g. “When I click”) here.
RulesEditor.trage_un_eveniment_in_dreapt: Drag an event to the right to start a rule, then drag the actions under it. It runs in Interaction mode (F5). To delete a block, drag it back onto the palette.
ScenesPanel.0_s_salt_direct_la_scena: 0 s = jump straight to the scene.
ScenesPanel.actualizeaza_cu_starea_curen: Update with the current state (camera and objects)
ScenesPanel.o_scena_retine_camera_si_sta: A scene keeps the camera and the state of the model (object positions, what is hidden), so you can return to it at any time — e.g. “Doors closed” and “Doors open”.
ScenesPanel.scena_noua_din_vederea_curen: New scene from the current view

ScriptConsole.un_plugin_un_dosar_cu_mani: A plugin = a folder with manifest.json (name, commands: { title, function }) and main.js. Its commands also appear in the palette (⌘K). Details in docs/scripting.md.
SoftenPanel.nicio_muchie_nu_e_sub_prag_m: No edge is under the threshold. A cube's edges are 90°: raise the threshold above 90°.
SoftenPanel.selectia_nu_are_muchii_intre: The selection has no edges between two faces.
SoftenPanel.sub_prag_muchia_dispare_si_u: Under the threshold, the edge disappears and the shading flows smoothly over it (as on a cylinder). It adds no faces: to make the object rounder, use Subdivide. 0° = all edges visible.
StartScreen.1_2_si_3_trec_intre_modelare: ⌥1, ⌥2 and ⌥3 switch between Model, Animate and Interact.
StartScreen.am_pastrat_copiile_salvate_a: We kept the autosaved copies of the documents you were working on.
StartScreen.am_pastrat_ultima_copie_salv: We kept the last autosaved copy of the document you were working on.
StartScreen.documentele_pe_care_le_salve: The documents you save or open appear here.
StartScreen.fisierele_aion_pastreaza_si_: .aion files also keep a thumbnail: you see it here, in the recent list.
StartScreen.k_cauta_orice_comanda_unealt: ⌘K finds any command, tool or recent document.
StartScreen.tasteaza_o_lungime_in_timp_c: Type a length while you draw (e.g. 2.4m) and press Enter.
StartScreen.tine_cursorul_pe_o_unealta_d: Hold the pointer over a toolbar tool: an animated guide shows you how to use it.
SubdividePanel.fiecare_nivel_imparte_fet: Each level splits the faces in four and rounds the shape: a cube becomes a cushion, a sphere becomes smoother. To keep straight edges, Bevel them first.
TagsPanel.optionale_pune_acelasi_tag_pe_: Optional: put the same tag on items in different groups (e.g. all the walls) to hide or select them together.
Timeline.auto_key_oprit_schimbarile_ajus: Auto-key off: changes adjust the base pose (and the whole animation of the animated properties)
Timeline.auto_key_pornit_move_rotate_sca: Auto-key on: Move, Rotate, Scale and the Inspector set keyframes
Timeline.creeaza_o_animatie_meniul_din_s: Create an animation (the menu at the top left), then: place the object, press ◆ (K), move the playhead, change the object's position and press ◆ again.
Timeline.keyframe_pe_selectie_pozitie_ro: Keyframe the selection: position, rotation, scale
Timeline.selecteaza_un_obiect_si_muta_l_: Select an object and move it, rotate it or press ◆ (K): each changed property becomes a channel, visible when you expand the object (▸).
TimelineRow.keyframe_pe_toate_proprietat: Keyframe all properties at the current time
TimelineRow.trage_startul_capatul_drept_: Drag: the start · right end: the duration · double-click: the travel curve
ToolGuides.activeaza_sau_dezactiveaza_ta: Turn the cut on or off at any time
ToolGuides.adauga_cote_care_raman_in_mod: Adds dimensions that stay in the model and update themselves.
ToolGuides.alege_latura_balamalei_sau_di: Choose the hinge side (or the direction) and the angle (or the distance)
ToolGuides.alege_muchii_fete_grupuri_si_: Picks edges, faces, groups and objects, so you can work with them.
ToolGuides.alege_un_material_din_panoul_: Pick a material in the Materials panel
ToolGuides.aplica_materiale_pe_fete_grup: Applies materials to faces, groups and objects.
ToolGuides.apropie_sau_departeaza_camera: Moves the camera closer or farther.
ToolGuides.arcul_e_o_singura_curba_erase: The arc is a single curve: Eraser deletes it whole
ToolGuides.click_pe_coltul_opus_sau_tast: Click the opposite corner or type 600,400
ToolGuides.click_pe_o_fata_a_corpului_ax: Click a face of the carcass: the axis is its normal
ToolGuides.click_pe_o_fata_planul_se_asa: Click a face: the plane lies parallel to it
ToolGuides.click_pe_o_fata_sau_o_muchie_: Clicking a face or an edge selects it
ToolGuides.click_pe_o_muchie_si_trage_ap: Click an edge and drag: a parallel guide appears
ToolGuides.click_pe_primul_capat_apoi_pe: Click the first end, then the second
ToolGuides.click_pe_primul_colt_pe_o_fat: Click the first corner, on a face or on the ground
ToolGuides.click_pe_un_maner_colt_unifor: Click a handle: corner = uniform, middle of an edge = two axes, center of a face = one axis
ToolGuides.click_pe_varful_unghiului: Click the vertex of the angle
ToolGuides.click_pentru_centrul_bazei: Click for the center of the base
ToolGuides.click_pentru_centrul_bazei_pe: Click for the center of the base (on a face: in its plane)
ToolGuides.click_pentru_primul_punct_apo: Click for the first point, then click for the next
ToolGuides.click_unde_vrei_eticheta: Click where you want the label
ToolGuides.copiaza_conturul_unei_fete_la: Copies the outline of a face at a constant distance, inward or outward.
ToolGuides.creeaza_direct_un_obiect_cub_: Creates a cube object directly (with its faces), ready to move, rotate or resize.
ToolGuides.creeaza_ghidaje_la_un_unghi_d: Creates guides at a given angle.
ToolGuides.creeaza_un_obiect_cilindru_cu: Creates a cylinder object, with its base on the chosen plane.
ToolGuides.creeaza_un_obiect_con_cu_baza: Creates a cone object, with its base on the chosen plane.
ToolGuides.creeaza_un_obiect_sfera_cu_su: Creates a sphere object, with a smooth surface, resting on the chosen plane.
ToolGuides.cu_interact_click_pe_obiect_s: With Interact, click the object: it opens; click again: it closes
ToolGuides.culoarea_raportorului_arata_p: The protractor's color shows the plane: blue = horizontal
ToolGuides.deplaseaza_vederea_fara_sa_o_: Moves the view without rotating it.
ToolGuides.deschide_si_inchide_usile_ser: Opens and closes the doors, drawers and flaps you gave an interaction to.
ToolGuides.deseneaza_muchii_cand_liniile: Draws edges. When the lines close a flat outline, a face appears automatically.
ToolGuides.deseneaza_o_placa_de_mobilier: Draws a furniture board (PAL 18 by default) right on a face: the thickness goes outward.
ToolGuides.deseneaza_un_arc_din_doua_cap: Draws an arc from two ends and a bulge (how curved it is).
ToolGuides.deseneaza_un_cerc_ca_poligon_: Draws a circle (as a polygon with many sides) with a face inside.
ToolGuides.deseneaza_un_dreptunghi_din_d: Draws a rectangle from two opposite corners; the face appears right away.
ToolGuides.deseneaza_un_poligon_regulat_: Draws a regular polygon (a hexagon by default).
ToolGuides.dimensiunile_se_pot_schimba_a: The dimensions can then be changed in the Inspector
ToolGuides.dublu_click_fata_cu_muchiile_: Double-click: the face with its edges; triple-click: everything connected
ToolGuides.dublu_click_repeta_ultima_dis: Double-click repeats the last distance; Option (⌥) keeps the starting face
ToolGuides.fibra_merge_pe_latura_mai_lun: The grain runs along the longer side; the board appears in the cut list
ToolGuides.ghidajele_participa_la_infere: Guides take part in inference; delete them from Edit → Delete guides
ToolGuides.gizmo_ul_din_colt_duce_la_ved: The gizmo in the corner goes to the standard views
ToolGuides.ia_materialul_de_pe_o_fata_in: ⌥ picks the material from a face; ⇧ replaces the same material everywhere
ToolGuides.lateste_sau_inalta_un_corp_fa: Widens (or raises) a carcass made of boards: the boards cut by the plane get longer, the ones beyond it move.
ToolGuides.mareste_sau_micsoreaza_select: Enlarges or shrinks the selection: uniformly, on two axes or on one.
ToolGuides.masoara_distante_si_creeaza_g: Measures distances and creates guides for precise drawing.
ToolGuides.misca_de_a_lungul_unei_axe_si: Move along an axis and click
ToolGuides.misca_mouse_ul_ca_sa_alegi_bo: Move the mouse to choose the bulge, then click
ToolGuides.misca_mouse_ul_pentru_diametr: Move the mouse for the diameter and click
ToolGuides.misca_mouse_ul_pentru_distant: Move the mouse for the distance and click, or type 200 (or 200/2: in 2 equal places)
ToolGuides.misca_mouse_ul_pentru_inaltim: Move the mouse for the height (it snaps level with nearby points) and click
Move the mouse for the height and click
ToolGuides.misca_mouse_ul_pentru_latime_: Move the mouse for the width (diameter) and click
Move the mouse for the width and click
ToolGuides.misca_mouse_ul_pentru_raza_si: Move the mouse for the radius and click
ToolGuides.misca_mouse_ul_si_da_click_pe: Move the mouse and click for the opposite corner
ToolGuides.misca_mouse_ul_spre_interior_: Move the mouse inward or outward, then click
ToolGuides.muchiile_poligonului_raman_se: The polygon's edges stay separate, unlike a circle's
ToolGuides.muta_planul_de_taiere_cu_mous: Move the cutting plane with the mouse and click
ToolGuides.muta_planul_din_bara_viewport: Move the plane from the viewport bar (the Sections icon)
ToolGuides.muta_selectia_sau_cu_option_o: Moves the selection or, with Option (⌥), copies it.
ToolGuides.mutand_o_muchie_sau_un_varf_f: Moving an edge or a vertex deforms the shapes (roofs, slopes)
ToolGuides.pe_o_fata_existenta_dreptungh: On an existing face, the rectangle splits it
ToolGuides.punctul_opus_manerului_ramane: The point opposite the handle stays put; with Option you scale from the center, and a negative factor mirrors
ToolGuides.pune_o_nota_cu_sageata_pe_mod: Puts a note with an arrow on the model.
ToolGuides.push_pull_pe_un_cerc_face_un_: Push/Pull on a circle makes a smooth cylinder
ToolGuides.roteste_camera_in_jurul_model: Rotates the camera around the model.
ToolGuides.roteste_selectia_in_jurul_unu: Rotates the selection around a point, with the protractor.
ToolGuides.roteste_si_da_click_sau_taste: Rotate and click, or type the angle
Rotate and click, or type the angle (30)
ToolGuides.sagetile_blocheaza_directia_p: The arrow keys lock the direction to an axis; Esc stops the line
ToolGuides.sau_oricand_butonul_din_mijlo: Or any time: the middle button / two fingers on the trackpad
ToolGuides.sau_oricand_shift_butonul_din: Or any time: Shift + the middle button
ToolGuides.sau_rotita_mouse_ului_pinch_p: Or the mouse wheel / pinch on the trackpad
ToolGuides.sau_tasteaza_diametrul_si_ina: Or type the diameter and the height (600,1200)
Or type the diameter and the height (600,1500)
ToolGuides.sau_tasteaza_distanta_1_5m_si: Or type the distance (1.5m) and press Enter
ToolGuides.sau_tasteaza_factorul_2_0_5_o: Or type the factor: 2, 0.5 or 2,1,1.5 (X, Y, Z)
ToolGuides.sau_tasteaza_latimea_1000_ori: Or type the width (1000) or the width and the height (1000,500)
ToolGuides.sau_tasteaza_latimea_si_lungi: Or type the width and the length: 3000,2000
ToolGuides.sau_tine_apasat_si_trece_pest: Or hold the button down and sweep over several edges
ToolGuides.scrie_textul_si_apasa_enter: Type the text and press Enter
ToolGuides.selecteaza_un_grup_si_alege_i: Select a group and choose in Entity Info → Interaction: Hinge or Slide
ToolGuides.shift_adauga_sau_scoate_din_s: Shift adds to or removes from the selection
ToolGuides.starea_deschis_inchis_se_salv: The open / closed state is saved in the file and can be undone
ToolGuides.sterge_muchii_si_fetele_care_: Deletes edges (and the faces that depend on them).
ToolGuides.stergerea_unei_muchii_dintre_: Deleting an edge between two coplanar faces merges them
ToolGuides.taie_modelul_cu_un_plan_ca_sa: Cuts the model with a plane, so you can see inside (plans, sections).
ToolGuides.tasteaza_distanta_dupa_copier: Type the distance; after copying, x3 makes three copies
ToolGuides.tasteaza_lungimea_de_exemplu_: Type the length (e.g. 3m) and press Enter
ToolGuides.tasteaza_numarul_de_laturi_ur: Type the number of sides followed by s (8s)
ToolGuides.tasteaza_raza_sau_numarul_de_: Type the radius or the number of sides (e.g. 48s)
ToolGuides.tasteaza_sageata_sau_numarul_: Type the bulge or the number of segments (e.g. 12s)
ToolGuides.tipul_si_grosimea_placii_noi_: The type and thickness of the new board are chosen in the Inspector while the tool is active
ToolGuides.trage_cota_in_afara_si_da_cli: Pull the dimension outward and click
ToolGuides.trage_o_fata_in_sus_sau_in_jo: Pulls a face up or down and turns flat shapes into volumes.
ToolGuides.trage_spre_dreapta_doar_ce_e_: Drag to the right: only what is fully inside the rectangle; to the left: everything it touches
ToolGuides.un_corp_din_biblioteca_isi_sc: A library carcass only changes its field; a board changed by hand stops the stretch
ToolGuides.unitatea_cotelor_se_schimba_d: The dimension unit is changed in Preferences (⌘,)
ToolGuides.urmeaza_inferentele_capat_mij: Follow the inferences: endpoint, midpoint, the colored axes
ToolGuides.util_pentru_rame_borduri_si_p: Useful for frames, borders and walls with thickness
ToolGuides.va_extruda_un_profil_de_a_lun: Will extrude a profile along a path (mouldings, pipes, borders).
ViewportControls.latitudinea_umbrirea_am: Latitude, ambient occlusion and quality are changed in Preferences (⌘,).
ViewportControls.usile_inchise_click_des: Doors closed (click: open, to see inside)
